name: JustAsk — AI Customer Support Assistant
author: chatmandesign

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the JustAsk plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Connect your site to JustAsk WP.
  3. Choose which WordPress content the assistant should know.
sections.description:
The easy way to add an AI customer support assistant that answers visitor questions about your WordPress content, without having to manage AI providers, models, prompts, or knowledge bases. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7FkcCdQzwjI Turn your website content into instant customer support. Powered by JustAsk WP, the plugin adds a conversational AI assistant to your WordPress site that answers visitor questions based on your content, including pages, posts, and custom post types. Unlike other AI chatbot plugins, JustAsk doesn’t require you to research AI providers, set up third-party accounts, choose AI models, or manually build a knowledge base. Just sign up, choose which content to include, and your new customer service rep is ready in minutes. How it works: When you activate the plugin, it loads the content you’ve selected into an AI assistant that answers visitor questions in natural conversation. Content changes are updated automatically within minutes, so there’s no manual importing. Key features: No separate AI accounts to manage. Automatically reads your WordPress content. Automatic content sync. Designed for accuracy. Lightweight widget with no impact on site performance. Who is it for? WordPress site owners with valuable content who want to make it easy for visitors to find answers. Beneficial for businesses with educational content, product documentation, knowledge bases, or just a large FAQ.

Features

  • Answers questions using your site content (posts, pages, and custom post types)
  • Accessible from floating chat button or embed on any page
  • Customizable appearance, including colors, corner radius, and button design
  • Customizable welcome message and suggested questions
  • Review conversation history
  • WooCommerce and Sensei LMS integration

Does it work with any WordPress site?

Yes. If your site runs WordPress, JustAsk WP can work with it. It’s compatible with any standard theme or plugins.

What if my content changes?

JustAsk WP stays in sync automatically. When you update a page or publish a new post, it’s also uploaded to your AI knowledge base. You’ll typically see the new information reflected in responses in less than a minute.

What kind of questions can it answer?

Anything addressed in your content. If a question falls outside your content, it will let the visitor know and suggest reaching out to you directly.

Do I need to have a separate AI account?

No. You will receive a license key from JustAsk WP when you subscribe. That’s all you need.

How does this compare with other chatbot plugins?

Most WordPress chatbot plugins require that you sign up for a separate AI service and pay for API usage in addition to cost of the plugin. Those API costs vary month to month and can be hard to budget for. With JustAsk WP, you don’t need anything else. One subscription, that’s it.

How accurate is it?

In internal testing with a content-heavy client site, we’ve seen accuracy of about 95%. AI assistants do make occasional mistakes – just like humans – but our solution bases answers off semantic search, which ensures the best possible accuracy.

Will it slow down my website?

No. The chat widget is lightweight, and the AI processing happens in the cloud, not on your server.

What if a visitor needs to talk to a real person?

When the AI can’t find an answer in your content, it recommends the visitor contact you directly.

External services

This plugin connects to external services to provide AI assistant functionality, license management, and optional integration with analytics. Depending on which features are enabled, information may be transmitted to these services.

JustAsk WP

JustAsk WP provides AI-powered customer support responses. The plugin sends information required to process the conversation, including visitor messages, site content, and technical information required to process the request.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Polar

Polar is used to process JustAsk WP subscriptions and manage licenses. The plugin sends the license key and related information required to identify and manage the licensed installation to Polar when the plugin needs to verify or manage a JustAsk WP license.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Google Tag Manager

Google Tag Manager can optionally be enabled by the site owner to track statistics related to chat usage via their own Google account. When enabled, the chat panel loads the configured Google Tag Manager container from Google’s servers. Data transmitted depends on the tags configured by the site owner and may include standard HTTP request information and tag-firing diagnostics.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy
